title: Fatima follows a river to the mountains

scenes.caption: A source.
scenes.say: Fatima starts at the source, high in the snowy mountains.

scenes.caption: Melting snow.
scenes.say: Melting snow becomes a small, fast stream.

scenes.caption: Tributaries.
scenes.say: Tributaries join the stream, and it grows into a river.

scenes.caption: Climate zones.
scenes.say: Latitude and height give different climates along the way.

scenes.caption: Meanders.
scenes.say: On the plain, the river bends into wide meanders.

scenes.caption: A flood.
scenes.say: In the monsoon, the river floods the plain.

scenes.caption: The mouth.
scenes.say: At the mouth, the river meets the Arabian Sea.

scenes.caption: Biomes.
scenes.say: Fatima has crossed mountain, plain and coast, each with its own biome.
